releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.30 — voice messages are real. Holding the mic now records through MediaRecorder (AAC/.m4a), uploads the clip, and sends it with its media_url and duration, so the other side actually hears it; bubbles play back through MediaPlayer with a real progress bar and can be paused, on both 1:1 and group chats. Chats tab is 1:1 only (groups stay in Groups), ongoing conversations survive a refresh, and Find shows Message instead of Add for anyone you already talk to, with an instant Cancel after you tap Add.
